invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of execute(), which is expected to be non-null unless there is an internal error.
The returned object is always a HoodieWriteMetadata as per the method signature.
HoodieWriteMetadata should always provide a non-null list of WriteStatus after an overwrite action.
The list of WriteStatus in the write metadata should have a non-negative size.
The records parameter is passed to the executor and must be non-null for normal operation.
